snippet.title: Half Sword - Convergence trailer
snippet.description:
The official Half Sword convergence trailer! Half Sword Games partnered with Game Seer proudly presents Half Sword, an immersive physics-based combat simulator. With innovative gameplay mechanics, feel the weight of your weapons and the consequences of their devastating blows. 

Experience being a commoner-turned-knight, by fighting in brutal tournaments of 15th-century Europe, featuring a wide array of historically accurate arms and armor. Become the champion of the Arena by besting your opponents in various brawls and arena bouts. 

Test your skills now, join our Playtest on Steam. Experience the innovative combat controls and become a part of the development with feedback! 


Get the Playtest and Wishlist on Steam!
https://s.team/a/2397300/

Join us on Discord!
